subjects.label: Earlier LEGO games and the series
subjects.description: How this game stands against the earlier LEGO games it remakes and the LEGO series as a whole: the original and the Complete Saga, nostalgia for them, whether the fully voiced dialogue loses the old mumbled charm, and where it ranks among LEGO games; comparisons with games outside the LEGO series stay under genre.

subjects.label: Collectibles and completion
subjects.description: The completionist checklist: studs, kyber bricks, minikits, data cards, characters and ships to unlock, level challenges and whether they register, how many there are and how long full completion takes; the story levels themselves do not belong here.

subjects.label: Children and family play
subjects.description: Who the game is for: whether it suits young children, playing it together with a son or daughter, and whether adults enjoy it as much as the children it is made for; the wider player community does not belong here.

subjects.label: Gags and small details
subjects.description: The visual gags, easter eggs and small touches players spot, such as a recurring joke kept from the earlier games, a character placed somewhere absurd or a droid leaving tread marks; the written jokes and dialogue stay under story.

subjects.label: Film quotes as reviews
subjects.description: The review is a line or scene from the source films quoted for its own sake and says nothing about the game; a review that judges how the game handles a scene from the films belongs under licensing instead.

subjects.label: Open-world planets and side missions
subjects.description: Exploring the open-world planets between story levels and the side missions found there, how much there is to explore and whether it is too much; the collectible checklist has its own row.

subjects.label: Lightsaber and blaster combat
subjects.description: Swinging a lightsaber or firing a blaster: how the combat feels, smashing bricks with it, how much fighting there is and which characters' weapons are overpowered; puzzles and traversal stay under gameplay.
